_comment: Attack-button weapons. Timings in seconds; hitbox [w, h] px, placed `reach` px from the player's centre along the attack direction. aimable weapons follow free-aim (LT); the others swing in the facing direction. latch (the whip): a swing whose aim line meets a whip point (layer whip) within reach + hitbox width / 2 latches on — or, if it misses, the nearest whip point within latch_assist_deg of the aim, in reach and in sight and the player swings from it on a rope of fixed length (no climbing). swing_pump px/s² is how hard left/right drives the swing; jump lets go with the swing's velocity, its y no slower than swing_release_hop.
